newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight, one-week rates lower.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight, one-week rates lower.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell in a liquid Thursday market to between 9-3/4 and 9-7/8 percent compared to Wednesday's range of 9-7/8 to 10-1/8 percent, private sector bankers said.
They also quoted one-week rates of around 9-7/8 percent, down from 10 and 10-1/8 percent on Wednesday.
The market is usually liquid on Thursday, the last trading day of the banking week.
Public sector banks kept their rates steady at around 10-1/2 percent. -- Cairo newsroom +20 2 578 3290/1
